question: Should OpenClaw expose live logs and command output as bundled trusted dashboard widgets, and what backend/security boundary should own their stream and output data sources?
rationale: The requested capability is not a simple repair: it depends on unmerged dashboard architecture and on a security boundary for operational logs and command output that automation should not choose independently.

options.title: Stage After Dashboard Substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open under the modular dashboard roadmap, land the dashboard substrate first, then require scoped log/output APIs, allowlists, redaction, and tests before widget implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Log Tail Only
options.body: Approve a smaller first pass that exposes read-only redacted gateway log tails as a trusted builtin while deferring command-output widgets until command binding policy is settled.

options.title: Defer From Core
options.body: Close or move the feature out of core if maintainers decide operational logs and command output should remain in existing CLI/Control UI surfaces or an external plugin.

recommendation.title: Stage After Dashboard Substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under the modular dashboard roadmap, land the dashboard substrate first, then require scoped log/output APIs, allowlists, redaction, and tests before widget implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history points to this account across the affected gateway and Control UI surfaces, making it the best available owner signal for the product/security boundary decision.
